description: Header file defining the Bluetooth Mesh Solicitation PDU RPL Client model, including data structures, function prototypes, and macros for managing RPL entries and callbacks.

methods.name: bt_mesh_sol_pdu_rpl_clear
methods.description: Removes entries from the Solicitation PDU RPL within a specified address range, optionally waiting for a response.

methods.name: bt_mesh_sol_pdu_rpl_clear_unack
methods.description: Removes entries from the Solicitation PDU RPL within a specified address range without waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: bt_mesh_sol_pdu_rpl_cli_timeout_set
methods.description: Sets the transmission timeout value for the RPL client.
